title: Revealing Inter-Channel Modality Discriminability: Channel Selective Interaction Fusion Network for Optical-SAR Object Detection

problem.summary: However, substantial cross-modal discrepancies and indiscriminate channel interaction inevitably introduce redundant or conflicting features.

background.summary: To address this issue, we propose the Channel Selective Interaction Fusion Network (CSIF-Net), which performs selective channel-level cross-modal interaction.

evidence.quote: To address this issue, we propose the Channel Selective Interaction Fusion Network (CSIF-Net), which performs selective channel-level cross-modal interaction.
CSIF-Net first employs a frequency decomposition module to construct frequency-aware SAR inputs, facilitating the separation of structural information from noise-related responses.

solution.summary: To provide an intuitive understanding of CSIF-Net, we visualize intermediate features from two perspectives: singlechannel features before and after fusion, and multi-channel features under different fusion strategies.
